newsitem.title: USA: Bev-Tyme Sipper resigns as president.
newsitem.headline: Bev-Tyme Sipper resigns as president.

text.p: Bev-Tyme Inc said Wednesday that Robert Sipper had resigned as president of the company effective July 7.
Bev-Tyme said in a statement Sipper also resigned as chief operating officer and vice president of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mootch & Muck Inc.
"His resignation from the company will permit Robert to devote his full efforts to his responsibilities as chief executive officer of Perry's Majestic Beer Inc Inc," it said.
A Bev-Tyme official said the company was looking for a successor.
Bev-Tyme distributes and markets beverages, beers and snacks through Mootch & Muck Inc in New York.
